items.q: What exactly do I receive after payment?
items.a: Once payment is confirmed, we send you a briefing form. Based on your answers, we build your landing page from scratch — design, development and (on Growth and Pro plans) copywriting included.

items.q: How is the landing page delivered?
items.a: We deliver the complete files (HTML/CSS/JS) and, on the Pro plan, deploy directly to your server or Vercel. On Starter and Growth plans, you can request deployment for a small additional fee.
It means you can request any changes you want — colors, text, layout, sections — at no extra cost. We only close the project when you confirm you're 100% satisfied.

items.q: What if I don't like the result?
items.a: Our full money-back guarantee applies. Just send an email to Lucasbreno@proton.me and we refund the full amount, no questions asked.

items.q: Do you need access to my domain?
items.a: Only on the Pro plan, where deployment is included. On other plans, we deliver the files and you (or your developer) upload them to whichever server you prefer.

items.q: Do you work with clients outside Portugal?
items.a: Yes. We work with clients across Europe and beyond. Communication can be in Portuguese, Spanish or English.

items.q: What is the difference between plans?
items.a: Essentially, the number of sections, inclusion of copywriting, SEO level and technical extras. The Growth plan is our best-seller for balancing quality and cost.
Payment is made securely via Stripe, by credit or debit card. You receive a receipt immediately by email.
